title: In vivo CRISPR screening identifies SAGA complex members as key regulators of hematopoiesis
model: Mouse HSPCs, 10 Bassik knockout sub-libraries transplanted in vivo (one pool per sub-library), plus a second GE sub-library transplant
contrast: All mature lineages vs c-Kit+ Lin- HSPCs: per sub-library 1 vs 1 (no replicates), and GE sub-library 2 vs 2 across two transplants; screening-level
paper_calls: 33 genes at casTLE BH 0.10 genome-wide (HSPC vs all lineages); 4 in the GE screen (Tada2b, Taf5l, Taf6l, Nop2)
barcs_calls: 109 genes at FDR 0.10 over the 10 genome-wide sub-libraries (89 enriched in lineage, mostly HSPC dropout); 5 in the GE two-screen analysis; screening-level, oligoclonal libraries
named_hits: 1/5: Runx1 #1 (FDR 2e-104); Tada2b top HSPC-enriched GE gene but FDR 0.19; Taf5l, Taf6l, Tada1 not called
verdict: BARCS recovers Runx1 as the dominant HSPC-enriched knockout but not the SAGA subunits: the HSPC libraries are oligoclonal (top 1% of guides hold 82-99% of reads), and Tada2b's support comes from different expanded guides in each GE transplant.
